description: Delete up to 300 leads by id. Destructive write action — Marketo permanently removes the records.
embedding_description: Permanently remove lead records from Marketo's Lead Database by id, up to 300 per batch — a destructive, irreversible verb. Distinct from merge_leads (combines records into a winner rather than discarding them) and remove_leads_from_list (only removes list membership while the underlying lead record survives).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with results (Marketo's per-record array: id, status [deleted/skipped], reasons on skip), row_count, and tallies (a status -> count summary).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Destructive action — surface the tallies clearly (e.g. '5 deleted, 1 skipped: lead not found') so the caller can confirm the intended leads were removed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Delete a batch of leads from the configured Marketo instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing/empty lead_ids or more than 300 ids. marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Write Person — this write permission is NOT checked by check_setup (unverifiable without performing a write), so this may be the FIRST signal of the gap.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.permission_denied: add 'Read-Write Person' under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > <the API role> > Access API, then retry. Individual skipped records (e.g. lead not found) are in the results array, not an error.
